There is no dispute that the vehicle bearing registration No.MH-16/Q-1209 is involved in the accident in question and as on the date of accident the vehicle was insured by the appellant-insurance company.
Even if there is no  valid fitness certificate as on the date of accident, it is not the  defence available for the insurance company under Section  149(2) of the Act and it is not the condition which is  mentioned in the policy, but it is only an offence under the Motor Vehicles Act and the Insurance Company cannot  escape from the liability.
Thus, it is evident that the Act does not contemplate that if there is violation of any condition of the permit, the permit shall automatically be deemed to have been cancelled.
In fact competent authority has to pass an order before cancelling or suspending the permit after affording opportunity of hearing to the holder of permit.
